title: Inuvo to Host Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Conference Call on Thursday, November 12th at 4:15 P.M. ET
summary: LITTLE ROCK, Ark., Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Inuvo, Inc. (NYSE American: INUV), a provider of artificial intelligence-driven advertising
body_markdown:
LITTLE ROCK, Ark., Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Inuvo, Inc. (NYSE American: INUV), a provider of artificial intelligence-driven advertising technology, will host a conference call on Thursday, November 12, 2026, at 4:15 p.m. Eastern Time to discuss its financial results and provide a business update for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026.


**Conference Call Details:**


Date: Thursday, November 12, 2026
Time: 4:15 p.m. Eastern Time
Toll-free Dial-in Number: 1-800-717-1738
International Dial-in Number: 1-646-307-1865
Conference ID: 1122251
Webcast Link:[https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1777035&tp_key=f5a1b88357](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=HKVo41mk5rTSbzdFl6mckPjc51B9tmf6GHGR49bUx-M52-tZzG1DOpmDUQAQovc0-G7pOW7DAaUyhaV--SrQY8kR2frdog8cBy7_vEYrFfaYNBsaYW6KE2Owh0Lc2-EeggsuGs5Bkxc_yYwLUXka-05Ba2kleZBOnQdNQkjtjEAGLpCovm4DgJt10mZ8zObzBErFqIXWNVD1NADeGaE0Iz5fdzOzFA2P8gBvJb2K3_A=)


A telephone replay will be available through Thursday, December 3, 2026. To access the replay, please dial 1-844-512-2921 (domestic) or 1-412-317-6671 (international). At the system prompt, please enter the code 1122251 followed by the # sign. You will then be prompted for your name, company, and phone number. Playback will then automatically begin.


**About Inuvo**


*Inuvo, Inc. (NYSE American: INUV) provides artificial intelligence-driven solutions for modeling media audiences. IntentKey® AI, built on our issued patents, analyzes real-time media consumption to identify why prospects are interested in a product or brand, often identifying emerging audience shifts up to 24 hours before they become competitive in the open market. Inuvo’s AI does not rely on consumer IDs, supporting a privacy-by-design approach to advertising. To learn more, visit[www.inuvo.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=ElQFvj_ZbBvK4QKL5hC8y0xDObeOZmIIUpnGMFfcTTOKrfUlSexTKGeTqV5zdtDavnJ7pyIao0pZpK-CAJoFmw==) .*
